lines.beaver_en: The show's over! How were the seats?
lines.learner: 객석이 꽉 찼어. 지정석이라 잘 보였어.
lines.en: The seats were full. I had a reserved seat, so I could see well.
lines.roman: Gaekseogi kkwak chasseo. Jijeongseogira jal boyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: How was the samulnori in part one? I liked the sound.
lines.beaver_roman: Ilbu samullorineun eottaesseo? Nan soriga joteora.
lines.learner: 농악이랑 사물놀이 정말 신났어. 피리도 좋았어.
lines.en: The farmers' music and samulnori were so fun. The flute was good too.
lines.roman: Nongagirang samullori jeongmal sinnasseo. Pirido joasseo.

lines.beaver_en: How were the pansori and folk songs in part two?
lines.en: The pansori singing was amazing. The folk songs too!

lines.beaver_en: There was a choir and orchestra stage too.
lines.learner: 가곡 합창도 좋고, 오케스트라 연주자들도 멋졌어.
lines.en: The art song choir was good, and the orchestra players were great.
lines.roman: Gagok hapchangdo joko, okeseuteura yeonjujadeuldo meotjeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: The last solo was a new song. It was trot, right?
lines.learner: 응, 트로트 신곡인데 계속 흥얼거리게 돼.
lines.en: Yeah, it's a new trot song, and I keep humming it.
lines.roman: Eung, teuroteu singoginde gyesok heungeolgeorige dwae.

lines.beaver_en: Are you going to the film festival next week too?
lines.learner: 응, 상영관에서 사극이랑 멜로를 볼 거야.
lines.en: Yes, I'll watch a historical drama and a melodrama at the theater.
lines.roman: Eung, sangyeonggwaneseo sageugirang melloreul bol geoya.

lines.beaver_en: I heard that historical drama is based on a novel?
lines.learner: 원작도 좋지만 대본이 더 좋다는 평이야.
lines.en: The original is good, but people say the script is even better.
lines.roman: Wonjakdo jochiman daeboni deo jotaneun pyeongiya.

lines.beaver_en: The producer is famous, right? I'm excited.
lines.learner: 응, 그 제작자 데뷔작이 영상미가 뛰어났어.
lines.en: Yeah, that producer's debut film had stunning visuals.
lines.roman: Eung, geu jejakja debwijagi yeongsangmiga ttwieonasseo.

lines.beaver: 영화 말고 또 볼 만한 거 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Is there anything else worth seeing besides movies?
lines.beaver_roman: Yeonghwa malgo tto bol manhan geo isseo?
lines.learner: 영화관 옆 전시관에서 한국 미술전도 해.
lines.en: There's also a Korean art exhibition in the hall next to the cinema.
lines.roman: Yeonghwagwan yeop jeonsigwaneseo hanguk misuljeondo hae.

lines.beaver: 좋다! 영화 보고 전시도 같이 보자.
lines.beaver_en: Great! Let's see the movie and the exhibition together.
lines.beaver_roman: Jota! Yeonghwa bogo jeonsido gachi boja.
lines.learner: 좋아, 멋진 예술품도 보고 맛있는 것도 먹자!
lines.en: Okay, let's see great works of art and eat something tasty too!
lines.roman: Joa, meotjin yesulpumdo bogo masinneun geotdo meokja!
